messages:
chao: quick heads-up, onboarding for zenith/30b finished upload but smoke tests flagged tokenizer + rope issues. weights at s3://redwood-models/zenith/30b/weights-v2.tar.gz

chao: log snippet from smoke run:
```
2026-03-10 14:12:03 ERROR runtime.runner: Rotary embedding out of range: pos=8192 max_pos=4096
2026-03-10 14:12:03 ERROR tokenizer: unknown token encountered: '�' -> [UNK]
2026-03-10 14:12:04 WARN serve.router: fallback triggered: unsupported_qk_layout -> fallback to generic-emu
```

anna: ok — which tokenizer version did you pick? v0.9 -> v1.0 changed merge rules and emoji handling. also, can you paste model-metadata.yaml?

chao: tokenizer.json indicates "version": "1.0" and merges from legacy-BPE. the [UNK]s are mostly emoji and Chinese punctuation. metadata shows head_groups: 1 and num_heads: 64. runtime interprets head_groups==1 as GQA but our MQA detector is stricter.

sara: pinging @ben for the GQA/MQA routing flags — is head_groups expected to be >1 for MQA?

ben: checking quickly. model-metadata.yaml currently: 
```
name: zenith-30b
num_heads: 64
head_groups: 1
qkv_layout: grouped
```
head_groups:1 => should be GQA (grouped qk per head), but our runtime has a corner case where qkv_layout==grouped + quantized kernels triggers unsupported_qk_layout. I'll push a metadata patch to mark gqa_compat: true.

lucas: separate note on RoPE scaling: our quantized kernel assumes freq_base scaled by 2x relative to upstream checkpoints. if pos values exceed max_pos, you either need to extend max_pos or apply rope.scale_factor: 0.5 to map positions. worth canarying the scale change.

chao: repro command I used:
```
python infra/tests/serve_smoke.py --model zenith/30b --input "hello world" --max-tokens 64
```
Traceback above at token 8192. we only requested 64 tokens so pos being that large hints at sliding-window / kv-cache indexing mismatch.

deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary zenith/30b-rope-patch at 1719234700 by ben. Status: queued.

anna: short checklist: 1) verify weights sha256 (chao pls paste), 2) ensure tokenizer-normalize step ran, 3) metadata updated for gqa_compat, 4) decide rope.scale_factor or max_pos bump for canary.

ben: weights sha256: abc123def456... (uploaded). pushed metadata change and opened PR #642 with runtime detection patch (git sha 9f7a3b). please retest after the canary deploy.

chao: re-ran smoke against ben's canary image — metadata fix removed the unsupported_qk_layout fallback, but rotary error still occurs until we adjust scale. applying rope.scale_factor=0.5 locally removes the pos overflow.

sara: can we add a temporary runtime fallback: if pos>max_pos then attempt rescales [scale=0.5,0.25] before failing? would help onboarding without long infra changes.

lucas: that fallback seems reasonable for canary only. i'll prototype a quick patch in runtime (cfg flag rope.auto_rescale=true). won't enable in prod yet.

anna: scheduling a short triage pairing tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize: tokenizer normalization, metadata/gqa tag, and rope rescale plan. @ben @chao please bring smoke logs and PR links. :white_check_mark:

chao: thanks — leaving notes in the onboarding checklist and will attach full logs + sha to the ticket once canary finishes.

ben: ack, will monitor deploy-bot and post canary results here.

sara: oncall note: non-prod canary only, no pager. see you tomorrow.
